grants.title: OAuth Grants
grants.subtitle: Active downstream OAuth grants issued to MCP clients that connected via the OAuth consent flow.

columns.boundToTooltip: The identity this grant is tied to: an end user (via SSO), a virtual key (shared by anyone using that VK), or an anonymous session. This determines which upstream per-user OAuth sessions are reachable under this grant.
columns.expiryTooltip: When the current JWT access token expires. MCP clients silently refresh using the refresh token, so an active grant past its expiry will mint a new token automatically on the next request.
columns.lastUsedTooltip: When this grant last refreshed its access token. MCP clients refresh as their token nears expiry, so this tracks the grant's most recent activity. Grants that have not refreshed since they were authorized fall back to when they were created.

grants.empty: No grants yet. Grants appear here when an MCP client connects via the OAuth consent flow. (Authentication Mode needs to be set to "oauth" or "both" for grants to be issued.)

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this OAuth grant?
revokeDialog.descriptionBefore: The refresh token for this grant stops rotating right away, so the MCP client can no longer renew its access. Its current access token is a short-lived JWT that keeps working on the
revokeDialog.descriptionAfter: endpoint until it expires (default 10 minutes), after which the client is fully cut off and must reconnect via the OAuth consent flow.
